Only four of our walkers journeyed to Birmingham for this annual event, but what we lost in team honours was compensated for in Bert Clayton's excellent performance in winning the individual scratch race.
It is with sincere regret that we record the passing of Bert Clayton at the early age of 39 years; and our heartfelt sympathy is extended to his Wife and three children.
Our walkers continued their string of good performances with a close 2nd in the National 20 mile Championship to Woodford Green with Harry Clayton in 4th spot.
